messages:
Nora (PM): quick check on post-launch fixes. need a compact rubric to split hotpatches vs next-wave enhancements. goal: minimize context switches for eng and protect customers.
Eli (ENG): agreed. can we have concrete signals: crash/outage, customer-blocker, metric delta, and #customers affected?
Samir (SRE): saw mem growth in worker pool and p99 latency bump on /embed yesterday at 01:13. synthetic tests alerted.
Dee (TPM): customers: one enterprise hit webhook timeouts that force retries; two pilots reported slow responses but have workarounds. also a request for model routing from a pilot.
Nora (PM): proposed rubric: hotpatch if outage/data-loss/revenue-impact OR >=2 enterprise customers impacted OR metric drop >3% on key metric. else next wave.
Eli (ENG): add operability clause: if incident increases ops cost >15% or backlog toil, treat as hotpatch.
Samir (SRE): agree. require a short runbook and an owner before a hotpatch.
Dee (TPM): I'll own customer comms for hotpatches and collate votes. can we add a Jira label hotpatch/nextwave?
Nora (PM): yes. engineering: reserve a softpatch slot (~15% capacity) for 8 working days to cover hotpatches.
Eli (ENG): ok. will add PR template with ship-risk flags and canary steps.
Samir (SRE): deployment rules: 5% canary for 30m + smoke tests + auto-rollback on p95 or error regress. ops-bot: created monitor hotpatch-canary-2267890000 watching p95_latency,error_rate,mem_rss.
Dee (TPM): triage sheet with customers impacted, metric delta, votes, and operability cost coming EOD.
Nora (PM): timeline: today triage+label; day2 owners assigned; day3-10 15% capacity reserved; day11 review and decide which fixes land in main sprint.
Eli (ENG): I'll create the Jira label and PR template now.
Samir (SRE): noted. will wire canary+rollback into deploy pipeline and post runbook snippet.
Nora (PM): action list: 1) Dee posts triage sheet (EOD) 2) Eli creates label & PR template 3) Samir wires canary+rollback 4) reconvene after 10 working days. :thumbsup:
